card.name: The word than after higher
card.fires_on: Mainly the word "than" right after a fold or times comparison with "higher", as in "6-fold higher than". It also fires weakly on small linking words that follow a quantity or degree word, such as "some or" and "degree of".

modes.label: Higher than, after a multiple
modes.description: "than" after a fold or times multiple plus "higher", comparing exposure to a reference level.
modes.example: at least 6-fold higher<< than>> the recommended dose

modes.label: Linking word after a quantity word
modes.description: A short linking word after words like some, degree or long, before the rest of the phrase.
modes.example: These crises are characterized by some<< or>> all of the following symptoms
